UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Synchronized Firestore user identity and privilege profile linking Google Sign-In authentication state with studio ownership and role governance.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID matching the Firestore document ID.

emailVerified.description: Whether the user email is verified by the identity provider.

role.description: Studio RBAC role synchronized with Cloud SQL and verified principal ownership.

isOwner.description: Explicit ownership privilege flag; true strictly when role is owner for the verified Principal Owner.

syncSource.description: Origin of the latest profile synchronization or link remediation.

lastSyncedAtIso.description: Client ISO timestamp of the latest synchronization.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp recorded when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated on every synchronization or repair write.

SiteMockup.title: SiteMockup
SiteMockup.description: Synchronized Site Mockup workspace document storing site branding, typography, copy, layout order, and slot media references for an authenticated owner.

ownerId.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the mockup workspace owner.

lastImportedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent website import.

clientUpdatedAt.description: Client ISO timestamp of the latest edit.

brand.description: Structured site branding map including name, industry, serviceArea, contact details, logoRef, palette, fontMood, and fontPairing.

brandSwatches.description: Bounded list (max 20) of extracted brand color swatches.

suggestedFontPairings.description: Bounded list (max 12) of suggested typography pairings.

hero.description: Hero copy, CTAs, trustHighlights (max 10), and hero photoRef.

services.description: Bounded list (max 24) of structured service cards.

projects.description: Bounded list (max 24) of featured project items with photoRef references.

about.description: About section heading, story, and credentials list (max 20).

quoteForm.description: Quote form heading, subtext, and submitLabel.

sectionVisibility.description: Visibility boolean flags for services, projects, about, and quote sections.

lockedSections.description: Lock boolean map for individual canvas sections.

siteNotes.description: Private site notes for the mockup.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated on every write.

SiteMockupMediaAsset.title: SiteMockupMediaAsset
SiteMockupMediaAsset.description: Individual compressed media asset belonging to a SiteMockup workspace, stored in a subcollection to keep documents well under the 1MB Firestore limit.

ownerId.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

assetId.description: Asset identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

slotKey.description: Optional direct slot binding key (e.g., brand_logo, hero_photo, project_<id>, or collection).

dataUrl.description: Compressed image data URL or HTTPS media URL (strictly bounded under 700KB).

addedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the asset was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated on every write.

PublicShareLink.title: PublicShareLink
PublicShareLink.description: Public-facing capability share link document stored in Firestore for Audio Briefings and Site Mockups, audited by the Owner Console PII & Sensitive Data Scanner.

shareId.description: Cryptographic capability share identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

status.description: Lifecycle status; non-active statuses immediately block public capability reads.

ownerId.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the creator or governing admin.

title.description: Public display title of the shared briefing or site mockup.

note.description: Optional public client note attached to the share link.

expiresAt.description: Firestore timestamp enforced by security rules to block expired public reads.

relinkedFromShareId.description: Previous compromised shareId when created via Scrub & Re-Link, or empty string.

relinkedToShareId.description: Replacement clean shareId when deactivated via Scrub & Re-Link, or empty string.

scrubbedAtIso.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when PII/sensitive payload scrubbing occurred, or empty string.

scrubbedFindingCount.description: Count of PII or sensitive data findings removed during Scrub & Re-Link (0 if original).

payload.description: Structured native map containing the serialized briefing or mockup share payload.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp set on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated on every write.

/userProfiles/{userId}.description: PII-isolated Firestore user identity and privilege profile documents restricted to the profile owner and verified Principal Owner.

/siteMockups/{mockupId}.description: Owner-scoped Site Mockup workspace documents storing live branding, layout, and copy state.

/siteMockups/{mockupId}/mediaAssets/{ass.description: Subcollection of compressed branding and media assets belonging to a SiteMockup workspace.

/publicShareLinks/{shareId}.description: Capability-ID public share link documents with non-enumerable public get, Principal Owner / owner-scoped list auditing, and atomic Scrub & Re-Link support.
